description: Defines an immutable data object representing a Fixed Deposit product, extending DepositProductData, with additional fields and template methods for creating instances with various configurations.

classes.name: FixedDepositProductData
classes.description: Immutable class representing a fixed deposit product with additional deposit-specific fields and template methods.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template FixedDepositProductData with default null or false values, used for UI dropdowns and initial setup.

methods.name: withCharges
methods.description: Returns a new FixedDepositProductData instance with specified charges added.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new FixedDepositProductData instance based on an existing one, with additional template options for dropdowns.

methods.name: withAccountingDetails
methods.description: Returns a new FixedDepositProductData instance with specified accounting mappings and account-related info.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new FixedDepositProductData instance based on an existing DepositProductData, with specific deposit terms and flags.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a minimal FixedDepositProductData with only id and name, other fields null, for lookup purposes.

methods.name: withInterestChart
methods.description: Returns a new FixedDepositProductData instance with specified interest rate charts.
